kot.name: ЗЦ сериал · Кот Учёный
kot.desc: A warm velvety male baritone, about fifty years old, slightly husky, a storyteller's sing-song fairy-tale delivery with playful mischief
kot.ref: У Лукоморья дуб зелёный, златая цепь на дубе том…

proshka.name: ЗЦ сериал · Прошка
proshka.desc: A bright ringing voice of a ten-year-old boy, fast, confident and cheeky, speaking with a grin
proshka.ref: Хэк! Сказки — сказками, а техника — вещь!

potap.name: ЗЦ сериал · Потап
potap.desc: A low booming voice of a ten-year-old boy, slow, good-natured and warm, a little clumsy

pelageya.name: ЗЦ сериал · Пелагея
pelageya.desc: A quiet voice of a nine-year-old girl, a breathy shy whisper with little pauses

yosha.name: ЗЦ сериал · Йоша
yosha.desc: The highest ringing voice of a six-year-old boy, energetic and stubborn, full of pressure

tishka.name: ЗЦ сериал · Тишка
tishka.desc: A sleepy voice of a tiny four-year-old child, drawling the vowels, cute and yawning
tishka.ref: Сказку! Кто мне сказку на ночь?

zven.name: ЗЦ сериал · Звенышко
zven.desc: A high ringing bell-like voice of a magical creature without age, bright, light and joyful

kuzma.name: ЗЦ сериал · Кузьма
kuzma.desc: A deep thick bass of a forty-five-year-old blacksmith, kind but terse, short chopped phrases

koschei.name: ЗЦ сериал · Кощей
koschei.desc: A dry, quiet, tired voice of an old man over sixty, cold and sad, slow, never shouting

kolobok.name: ЗЦ сериал · Колобок
kolobok.desc: A round cheerful bouncy voice of a little fairy-tale bun, high and sing-song, fast
kolobok.ref: Я от бабушки ушёл — а от тучи — укачусь!
